findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_cart, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, request_feature, get_seller, get_help · Private data: search_products, create_cart, quick_buy, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, get_buyer_profile, save_buyer_address, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, list_sellers, order_status, get_help · Public sink: checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, submit_feedback, request_feature, order_status, get_help · Destructive: get_cart, update_cart_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_cart, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, request_feature, get_seller, get_help · Private data: search_products, create_cart, quick_buy, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, get_buyer_profile, save_buyer_address, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, list_sellers, order_status, get_help · Public sink: checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, submit_feedback, request_feature, order_status, get_help · Destructive: get_cart, update_cart_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
